name: tobkiri-tabs
description: Focus-preserving browser-tab automation: a local MCP server and Chrome MV3 extension.

scripts.test:browser: node scripts/sync-cursor.mjs && node tests/cursor-dom.mjs && node tests/browser-live.mjs --browser chrome --extended --require-trusted && node tests/browser-live.mjs --browser msedge --extended --require-trusted
scripts.test:social: node scripts/sync-cursor.mjs && node demos/social/acceptance.mjs --browser chrome && node demos/social/acceptance.mjs --browser msedge
scripts.test:network: node scripts/sync-cursor.mjs && node demos/social/acceptance.mjs --browser chrome --network && node demos/social/acceptance.mjs --browser msedge --network
